ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قَدْ أَفْلَحَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ
en: (1) Certainly will the believers have succeeded:
tr: Qad aflaḥal-muʾminūn

ar: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى صَلَاتِهِمْ خَٰشِعُونَ
en: (2) They who are during their prayer humbly intent
tr: Al-ladhīna hum fī ṣalātihim khāshiʿūn

ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَنِ ٱللَّغْوِ مُعْرِضُونَ
en: (3) And they who turn away from ill speech
tr: Wal-ladhīna hum ʿanil-laghwi muʿriḍūn

ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِلزَّكَوٰةِ فَٰعِلُونَ
en: (4) And they who are observant of zakāh
tr: Wal-ladhīna hum liz-zakāti fāʿilūn

ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِفُرُوجِهِمْ حَٰفِظُونَ
en: (5) And they who guard their private parts
tr: Wal-ladhīna hum lifurūjihim ḥāfiẓūn

ar: إِلَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَزْوَٰجِهِمْ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَٰنُهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ غَيْرُ مَلُومِينَ
en: (6) Except from their wives or those their right hands possess,[947] for indeed, they will not be blamed -
enNotes: [947]- Female slaves or captives under their ownership.
tr: Illā ʿalā azwājihim aw mā malakat aymānuhum faʾinnahum ghayru malūmīn

ar: فَمَنِ ٱبْتَغَىٰ وَرَآءَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْعَادُونَ
en: (7) But whoever seeks beyond that, then those are the transgressors -
tr: Famanibtaghā warāʾa dhālika faʾulāʾika humul-ʿādūn

ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِأَمَٰنَٰتِهِمْ وَعَهْدِهِمْ رَٰعُونَ
en: (8) And they who are to their trusts and their promises attentive
tr: Wal-ladhīna hum liʾamānātihim waʿahdihim rāʿūn

ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَوَٰتِهِمْ يُحَافِظُونَ
en: (9) And they who carefully maintain their prayers -
tr: Wal-ladhīna hum ʿalā ṣalawātihim yuḥāfiẓūn

ar: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْوَٰرِثُونَ
en: (10) Those are the inheritors
tr: Ulāʾika humul-wārithūn

ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يَرِثُونَ ٱلْفِرْدَوْسَ هُمْ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ
en: (11) Who will inherit al-Firdaus.[948] They will abide therein eternally.
enNotes: [948]- The highest part of Paradise.
tr: Al-ladhīna yarithūnal-firdaws, hum fīhā khālidūn

ar: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِن سُلَٰلَةٍ مِّن طِينٍ
en: (12) And certainly did We create man from an extract of clay.
tr: Walaqad khalaqnal-insāna min sulālatim min ṭīn

ar: ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَٰهُ نُطْفَةً فِى قَرَارٍ مَّكِينٍ
en: (13) Then We placed him as a sperm-drop[949] in a firm lodging [i.e., the womb].
enNotes: [949]- Or "as a zygote."
tr: Thumma jaʿalnāhu nuṭfatan fī qarārim makīn

ar: ثُمَّ خَلَقْنَا ٱلنُّطْفَةَ عَلَقَةً فَخَلَقْنَا ٱلْعَلَقَةَ مُضْغَةً فَخَلَقْنَا ٱلْمُضْغَةَ عِظَٰمًا فَكَسَوْنَا ٱلْعِظَٰمَ لَحْمًا ثُمَّ أَنشَأْنَٰهُ خَلْقًا ءَاخَرَ فَتَبَارَكَ ٱللَّهُ أَحْسَنُ ٱلْخَٰلِقِينَ
en: (14) Then We made the sperm-drop into a clinging clot, and We made the clot into a lump [of flesh], and We made [from] the lump, bones, and We covered the bones with flesh; then We developed him into another creation. So blessed is Allāh, the best of creators.[950]
enNotes: [950]- i.e., the most skillful and only true Creator.
tr: Thumma khalaqnan-nuṭfata ʿalaqatan fakhalaqnal-ʿalaqata muḍghatan fakhalaqnal-muḍghata ʿiẓāman fakasawnal-ʿiẓāma laḥman thumma anshaʾnāhu khalqan ākhar, fatabārakallāhu aḥsanul-khāliqīn

ar: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُم بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ لَمَيِّتُونَ
en: (15) Then indeed, after that you are to die.
tr: Thumma innakum baʿda dhālika lamayyitūn

ar: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ تُبْعَثُونَ
en: (16) Then indeed you, on the Day of Resurrection, will be resurrected.
tr: Thumma innakum yawmal-qiyāmati tubʿathūn

ar: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا فَوْقَكُمْ سَبْعَ طَرَآئِقَ وَمَا كُنَّا عَنِ ٱلْخَلْقِ غَٰفِلِينَ
en: (17) And We have created above you seven layered heavens, and never have We been of [Our] creation unaware.
tr: Walaqad khalaqnā fawqakum sabʿa ṭarāʾiq, wamā kunnā ʿanil-khalqi ghāfilīn

ar: وَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۢ بِقَدَرٍ فَأَسْكَنَّٰهُ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰ ذَهَابٍۭ بِهِۦ لَقَٰدِرُونَ
en: (18) And We have sent down rain from the sky in a measured amount and settled it in the earth. And indeed, We are Able to take it away.
tr: Waʾanzalnā minas-samāʾi māʾam biqadarin faʾaskannāhu fil-arḍ, waʾinnā ʿalā dhahābim bihī laqādirūn

ar: فَأَنشَأْنَا لَكُم بِهِۦ جَنَّٰتٍ مِّن نَّخِيلٍ وَأَعْنَٰبٍ لَّكُمْ فِيهَا فَوَٰكِهُ كَثِيرَةٌ وَمِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ
en: (19) And We brought forth for you thereby gardens of palm trees and grapevines in which for you are abundant fruits and from which you eat.
tr: Faʾanshaʾnā lakum bihī jannātim min nakhīliw waʾaʿnāb, lakum fīhā fawākihu kathīratuw waminhā taʾkulūn

ar: وَشَجَرَةً تَخْرُجُ مِن طُورِ سَيْنَآءَ تَنۢبُتُ بِٱلدُّهْنِ وَصِبْغٍ لِّلْـَٔاكِلِينَ
en: (20) And [We brought forth] a tree issuing from Mount Sinai which produces oil and food [i.e., olives] for those who eat.
tr: Washajaratan takhruju min ṭūri saynāʾa tambutu bid-duhni waṣibghil lil-ākilīn

ar: وَإِنَّ لَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَنْعَٰمِ لَعِبْرَةً نُّسْقِيكُم مِّمَّا فِى بُطُونِهَا وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا مَنَٰفِعُ كَثِيرَةٌ وَمِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ
en: (21) And indeed, for you in livestock is a lesson. We give you drink from that which is in their bellies, and for you in them are numerous benefits, and from them you eat.
tr: Waʾinna lakum fil-anʿāmi laʿibrah, nusqīkum mimmā fī buṭūnihā walakum fīhā manāfiʿu kathīratuw waminhā taʾkulūn

ar: وَعَلَيْهَا وَعَلَى ٱلْفُلْكِ تُحْمَلُونَ
en: (22) And upon them and on ships you are carried.
tr: Waʿalayhā waʿalal-fulki tuḥmalūn

ar: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ فَقَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَٰهٍ غَيْرُهُۥٓ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
en: (23) And We had certainly sent Noah to his people, and he said, "O my people, worship Allāh; you have no deity other than Him; then will you not fear Him?"
tr: Walaqad arsalnā nūḥan ilā qawmihī faqāla yāqawmiʿbudullāha mā lakum min ilāhin ghayruh, afalā tattaqūn

ar: فَقَالَ ٱلْمَلَؤُا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن قَوْمِهِۦ مَا هَٰذَآ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُكُمْ يُرِيدُ أَن يَتَفَضَّلَ عَلَيْكُمْ وَلَوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَأَنزَلَ مَلَٰٓئِكَةً مَّا سَمِعْنَا بِهَٰذَا فِىٓ ءَابَآئِنَا ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
en: (24) But the eminent among those who disbelieved from his people said, "This is not but a man like yourselves who wishes to take precedence over you; and if Allāh had willed [to send a messenger], He would have sent down angels. We have not heard of this among our forefathers.
tr: Faqālal-malaʾul-ladhīna kafarū min qawmihī mā hādhā illā basharum mithlukum yurīdu ay yatafaḍḍala ʿalaykum, walaw shāʾallāhu laʾanzala malāʾikah, mā samiʿnā bihādhā fī ābāʾinal-awwalīn

ar: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا رَجُلٌۢ بِهِۦ جِنَّةٌ فَتَرَبَّصُوا۟ بِهِۦ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
en: (25) He is not but a man possessed with madness, so wait concerning him for a time."
tr: In huwa illā rajulum bihī jinnatun fatarabbaṣū bihī ḥattā ḥīn

ar: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱنصُرْنِى بِمَا كَذَّبُونِ
en: (26) [Noah] said, "My Lord, support me because they have denied me."
tr: Qāla rabbinṣurnī bimā kadhdhabūn

ar: فَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْهِ أَنِ ٱصْنَعِ ٱلْفُلْكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا وَوَحْيِنَا فَإِذَا جَآءَ أَمْرُنَا وَفَارَ ٱلتَّنُّورُ فَٱسْلُكْ فِيهَا مِن كُلٍّ زَوْجَيْنِ ٱثْنَيْنِ وَأَهْلَكَ إِلَّا مَن سَبَقَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلْقَوْلُ مِنْهُمْ وَلَا تُخَٰطِبْنِى فِى ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓا۟ إِنَّهُم مُّغْرَقُونَ
en: (27) So We inspired to him, "Construct the ship under Our observation and Our inspiration, and when Our command comes and the oven overflows,[951] put into it [i.e., the ship] from each [creature] two mates and your family, except him for whom the decree [of destruction] has proceeded. And do not address Me concerning those who have wronged; indeed, they are to be drowned.
enNotes: [951]- See footnote to 11:40.
tr: Faʾawḥaynā ilayhi aniṣnaʿil-fulka biʾaʿyuninā wawaḥyinā faʾidhā jāʾa amrunā wafārat-tannūru fasluk fīhā min kullin zawjaynithnayni waʾahlaka illā man sabaqa ʿalayhil-qawlu minhum, walā tukhāṭibnī fil-ladhīna ẓalamū, innahum mughraqūn

ar: فَإِذَا ٱسْتَوَيْتَ أَنتَ وَمَن مَّعَكَ عَلَى ٱلْفُلْكِ فَقُلِ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى نَجَّىٰنَا مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
en: (28) And when you have boarded the ship, you and those with you, then say, 'Praise to Allāh who has saved us from the wrongdoing people.'
tr: Faʾidhastawayta anta wamam maʿaka ʿalal-fulki faqulil-ḥamdu lillāhil-ladhī najjānā minal-qawmiẓ-ẓālimīn

ar: وَقُل رَّبِّ أَنزِلْنِى مُنزَلًا مُّبَارَكًا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلْمُنزِلِينَ
en: (29) And say, 'My Lord, let me land at a blessed landing place, and You are the best to accommodate [us].'"
tr: Waqur rabbi anzilnī munzalam mubārakaw waʾanta khayrul-munzilīn

ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَٰتٍ وَإِن كُنَّا لَمُبْتَلِينَ
en: (30) Indeed in that are signs, and indeed, We are ever testing [Our servants].
tr: Inna fī dhālika laʾāyātiw waʾin kunnā lamubtalīn

ar: ثُمَّ أَنشَأْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ قَرْنًا ءَاخَرِينَ
en: (31) Then We produced after them a generation of others.
tr: Thumma anshaʾnā mim baʿdihim qarnan ākharīn

ar: فَأَرْسَلْنَا فِيهِمْ رَسُولًا مِّنْهُمْ أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَٰهٍ غَيْرُهُۥٓ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
en: (32) And We sent among them a messenger[952] from themselves, [saying], "Worship Allāh; you have no deity other than Him; then will you not fear Him?"
enNotes: [952]- Prophet Hūd, who was sent to the tribe of ʿAad.
tr: Faʾarsalnā fīhim rasūlam minhum aniʿbudullāha mā lakum min ilāhin ghayruh, afalā tattaqūn

ar: وَقَالَ ٱلْمَلَأُ مِن قَوْمِهِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِلِقَآءِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ وَأَتْرَفْنَٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا مَا هَٰذَآ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُكُمْ يَأْكُلُ مِمَّا تَأْكُلُونَ مِنْهُ وَيَشْرَبُ مِمَّا تَشْرَبُونَ
en: (33) And the eminent among his people who disbelieved and denied the meeting of the Hereafter while We had given them luxury in the worldly life said, "This is not but a man like yourselves. He eats of that from which you eat and drinks of what you drink.
tr: Waqālal-malaʾu min qawmihil-ladhīna kafarū wakadhdhabū biliqāʾil-ākhirati waʾatrafnāhum fil-ḥayātid-dunyā mā hādhā illā basharum mithlukum yaʾkulu mimmā taʾkulūna minhu wayashrabu mimmā tashrabūn

ar: وَلَئِنْ أَطَعْتُم بَشَرًا مِّثْلَكُمْ إِنَّكُمْ إِذًا لَّخَٰسِرُونَ
en: (34) And if you should obey a man like yourselves, indeed, you would then be losers.
tr: Walaʾin aṭaʿtum basharam mithlakum innakum idhal lakhāsirūn

ar: أَيَعِدُكُمْ أَنَّكُمْ إِذَا مِتُّمْ وَكُنتُمْ تُرَابًا وَعِظَٰمًا أَنَّكُم مُّخْرَجُونَ
en: (35) Does he promise you that when you have died and become dust and bones that you will be brought forth [once more]?
tr: Ayaʿidukum annakum idhā mittum wakuntum turābaw waʿiẓāman annakum mukhrajūn

ar: هَيْهَاتَ هَيْهَاتَ لِمَا تُوعَدُونَ
en: (36) How far, how far, is that which you are promised.[953]
enNotes: [953]- i.e., how distant and improbable it is.
tr: Hayhāta hayhāta limā tūʿadūn

ar: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّا حَيَاتُنَا ٱلدُّنْيَا نَمُوتُ وَنَحْيَا وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَبْعُوثِينَ
en: (37) It [i.e., life] is not but our worldly life - we die and live, but we will not be resurrected.
tr: In hiya illā ḥayātunad-dunyā namūtu wanaḥyā wamā naḥnu bimabʿūthīn

ar: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا رَجُلٌ ٱفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا وَمَا نَحْنُ لَهُۥ بِمُؤْمِنِينَ
en: (38) He is not but a man who has invented a lie about Allāh, and we will not believe him."
tr: In huwa illā rajuluniftarā ʿalallāhi kadhibaw wamā naḥnu lahū bimuʾminīn

ar: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱنصُرْنِى بِمَا كَذَّبُونِ
en: (39) He said, "My Lord, support me because they have denied me."
tr: Qāla rabbinṣurnī bimā kadhdhabūn

ar: قَالَ عَمَّا قَلِيلٍ لَّيُصْبِحُنَّ نَٰدِمِينَ
en: (40) [Allāh] said, "After a little, they will surely become regretful."
tr: Qāla ʿammā qalīlil layuṣbiḥunna nādimīn

ar: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ بِٱلْحَقِّ فَجَعَلْنَٰهُمْ غُثَآءً فَبُعْدًا لِّلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
en: (41) So the shriek[954] seized them in truth,[955] and We made them as [plant] stubble. Then away with the wrongdoing people.
enNotes:
[954]- See footnote to 11:67.
[955]- i.e., by right or in justice.
tr: Faʾakhadhathumuṣ-ṣayḥatu bil-ḥaqqi fajaʿalnāhum ghuthāʾā, fabuʿdal lil-qawmiẓ-ẓālimīn

ar: ثُمَّ أَنشَأْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ قُرُونًا ءَاخَرِينَ
en: (42) Then We produced after them other generations.
tr: Thumma anshaʾnā mim baʿdihim qurūnan ākharīn

ar: مَا تَسْبِقُ مِنْ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسْتَـْٔخِرُونَ
en: (43) No nation will precede its time [of termination], nor will they remain [thereafter].
tr: Mā tasbiqu min ummatin ajalahā wamā yastaʾkhirūn

ar: ثُمَّ أَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلَنَا تَتْرَا كُلَّ مَا جَآءَ أُمَّةً رَّسُولُهَا كَذَّبُوهُ فَأَتْبَعْنَا بَعْضَهُم بَعْضًا وَجَعَلْنَٰهُمْ أَحَادِيثَ فَبُعْدًا لِّقَوْمٍ لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ
en: (44) Then We sent Our messengers in succession. Every time there came to a nation its messenger, they denied him, so We made them follow one another [to destruction], and We made them narrations.[956] So away with a people who do not believe.
enNotes: [956]- i.e., history or lessons for mankind.
tr: Thumma arsalnā rusulanā tatrā, kullamā jāʾa ummatar rasūluhā kadhdhabūhu faʾatbaʿnā baʿḍahum baʿḍaw wajaʿalnāhum aḥādīth, fabuʿdal liqawmil lā yuʾminūn

ar: ثُمَّ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ وَأَخَاهُ هَٰرُونَ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَسُلْطَٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ
en: (45) Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron with Our signs and a clear authority[957]
enNotes: [957]- i.e., evidences from Allāh.
tr: Thumma arsalnā mūsā waʾakhāhu hārūna biʾāyātinā wasulṭānim mubīn

ar: إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإِي۟هِۦ فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ وَكَانُوا۟ قَوْمًا عَالِينَ
en: (46) To Pharaoh and his establishment, but they were arrogant and were a haughty people.
tr: Ilā firʿawna wamalaʾihī fastakbarū wakānū qawman ʿālīn

ar: فَقَالُوٓا۟ أَنُؤْمِنُ لِبَشَرَيْنِ مِثْلِنَا وَقَوْمُهُمَا لَنَا عَٰبِدُونَ
en: (47) They said, "Should we believe two men like ourselves while their people are for us in servitude?"
tr: Faqālū anuʾminu libasharayni mithlinā waqawmuhumā lanā ʿābidūn

ar: فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَكَانُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْمُهْلَكِينَ
en: (48) So they denied them and were of those destroyed.
tr: Fakadhdhabūhumā fakānū minal-muhlakīn

ar: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَٰبَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ
en: (49) And We certainly gave Moses the Scripture that perhaps they[958] would be guided.
enNotes: [958]- The Children of Israel.
tr: Walaqad ātaynā mūsal-kitāba laʿallahum yahtadūn

ar: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱبْنَ مَرْيَمَ وَأُمَّهُۥٓ ءَايَةً وَءَاوَيْنَٰهُمَآ إِلَىٰ رَبْوَةٍ ذَاتِ قَرَارٍ وَمَعِينٍ
en: (50) And We made the son of Mary and his mother a sign and sheltered them within a high ground having level [areas] and flowing water.
tr: Wajaʿalnabna maryama waʾummahū āyataw waʾāwaynāhumā ilā rabwatin dhāti qarāriw wamaʿīn

ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلرُّسُلُ كُلُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَٰتِ وَٱعْمَلُوا۟ صَٰلِحًا إِنِّى بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ عَلِيمٌ
en: (51) [Allāh said], "O messengers, eat from the good foods and work righteousness. Indeed I, of what you do, am Knowing.
tr: Yā ayyuhar-rusulu kulū minaṭ-ṭayyibāti waʿmalū ṣāliḥā, innī bimā taʿmalūna ʿalīm

ar: وَإِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦٓ أُمَّتُكُمْ أُمَّةً وَٰحِدَةً وَأَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمْ فَٱتَّقُونِ
en: (52) And indeed this, your religion, is one religion,[959] and I am your Lord, so fear Me."
enNotes: [959]- See footnote to 21:92.
tr: Waʾinna hādhihī ummatukum ummataw wāḥidataw waʾana rabbukum fattaqūn

ar: فَتَقَطَّعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَهُم بَيْنَهُمْ زُبُرًا كُلُّ حِزْبٍۭ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ فَرِحُونَ
en: (53) But they [i.e., the people] divided their religion among them into portions [i.e., sects] - each faction, in what it has,[960] rejoicing.
enNotes: [960]- Of beliefs, opinions, customs, etc.
tr: Fataqaṭṭaʿū amrahum baynahum zuburā, kullu ḥizbim bimā ladayhim fariḥūn

ar: فَذَرْهُمْ فِى غَمْرَتِهِمْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
en: (54) So leave them in their confusion for a time.
tr: Fadharhum fī ghamratihim ḥattā ḥīn

ar: أَيَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّمَا نُمِدُّهُم بِهِۦ مِن مَّالٍ وَبَنِينَ
en: (55) Do they think that what We extend to them of wealth and children
tr: Ayaḥsabūna annamā numidduhum bihī mim māliw wabanīn

ar: نُسَارِعُ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ بَل لَّا يَشْعُرُونَ
en: (56) Is [because] We hasten for them good things? Rather, they do not perceive.[961]
enNotes: [961]- That the good things given to them in this world are but a trial for them.
tr: Nusāriʿu lahum fil-khayrāt, bal lā yashʿurūn

ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ هُم مِّنْ خَشْيَةِ رَبِّهِم مُّشْفِقُونَ
en: (57) Indeed, they who are apprehensive from fear of their Lord
tr: Innal-ladhīna hum min khashyati rabbihim mushfiqūn

ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ يُؤْمِنُونَ
en: (58) And they who believe in the signs of their Lord
tr: Wal-ladhīna hum biʾāyāti rabbihim yuʾminūn

ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِرَبِّهِمْ لَا يُشْرِكُونَ
en: (59) And they who do not associate anything with their Lord
tr: Wal-ladhīna hum birabbihim lā yushrikūn

ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُؤْتُونَ مَآ ءَاتَوا۟ وَّقُلُوبُهُمْ وَجِلَةٌ أَنَّهُمْ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ رَٰجِعُونَ
en: (60) And they who give what they give while their hearts are fearful[962] because they will be returning to their Lord -
enNotes: [962]- Lest their deeds not be acceptable.
tr: Wal-ladhīna yuʾtūna mā ātaw waqulūbuhum wajilatun annahum ilā rabbihim rājiʿūn

ar: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ يُسَٰرِعُونَ فِى ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ وَهُمْ لَهَا سَٰبِقُونَ
en: (61) It is those who hasten to good deeds, and they outstrip [others] therein.
tr: Ulāʾika yusāriʿūna fil-khayrāti wahum lahā sābiqūn

ar: وَلَا نُكَلِّفُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا وَلَدَيْنَا كِتَٰبٌ يَنطِقُ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ
en: (62) And We charge no soul except [with that within] its capacity, and with Us is a record which speaks with truth; and they will not be wronged.
tr: Walā nukallifu nafsan illā wusʿahā, waladaynā kitābuy yanṭiqu bil-ḥaqqi wahum lā yuẓlamūn

ar: بَلْ قُلُوبُهُمْ فِى غَمْرَةٍ مِّنْ هَٰذَا وَلَهُمْ أَعْمَٰلٌ مِّن دُونِ ذَٰلِكَ هُمْ لَهَا عَٰمِلُونَ
en: (63) But their hearts are covered with confusion over this, and they have [evil] deeds besides that [i.e., disbelief] which they are doing,
tr: Bal qulūbuhum fī ghamratim min hādhā walahum aʿmālum min dūni dhālika hum lahā ʿāmilūn

ar: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَآ أَخَذْنَا مُتْرَفِيهِم بِٱلْعَذَابِ إِذَا هُمْ يَجْـَٔرُونَ
en: (64) Until when We seize their affluent ones with punishment,[963] at once they are crying [to Allāh] for help.
enNotes: [963]- In worldly life, before the punishment of the Hereafter. Although general, the description includes specifically the punishment of the Quraysh by famine.
tr: Ḥattā idhā akhadhnā mutrafīhim bil-ʿadhābi idhā hum yajʾarūn

ar: لَا تَجْـَٔرُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ إِنَّكُم مِّنَّا لَا تُنصَرُونَ
en: (65) Do not cry out today. Indeed, by Us you will not be helped.
tr: Lā tajʾarul-yawm, innakum minnā lā tunṣarūn

ar: قَدْ كَانَتْ ءَايَٰتِى تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ فَكُنتُمْ عَلَىٰٓ أَعْقَٰبِكُمْ تَنكِصُونَ
en: (66) My verses had already been recited to you, but you were turning back on your heels
tr: Qad kānat āyātī tutlā ʿalaykum fakuntum ʿalā aʿqābikum tankiṣūn

ar: مُسْتَكْبِرِينَ بِهِۦ سَٰمِرًا تَهْجُرُونَ
en: (67) In arrogance regarding it,[964] conversing by night, speaking evil.
enNotes: [964]- The revelation. Or "him," i.e., the Prophet (ﷺ).
tr: Mustakbirīna bihī sāmiran tahjurūn

ar: أَفَلَمْ يَدَّبَّرُوا۟ ٱلْقَوْلَ أَمْ جَآءَهُم مَّا لَمْ يَأْتِ ءَابَآءَهُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
en: (68) Then have they not reflected over the word [i.e., the Qur’ān], or has there come to them that which had not come to their forefathers?
tr: Afalam yaddabbarul-qawla am jāʾahum mā lam yaʾti ābāʾahumul-awwalīn

ar: أَمْ لَمْ يَعْرِفُوا۟ رَسُولَهُمْ فَهُمْ لَهُۥ مُنكِرُونَ
en: (69) Or did they not know their Messenger, so they are toward him disacknowledging?
tr: Am lam yaʿrifū rasūlahum fahum lahū munkirūn

ar: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ بِهِۦ جِنَّةٌۢ بَلْ جَآءَهُم بِٱلْحَقِّ وَأَكْثَرُهُمْ لِلْحَقِّ كَٰرِهُونَ
en: (70) Or do they say, "In him is madness"? Rather, he brought them the truth, but most of them, to the truth, are averse.
tr: Am yaqūlūna bihī jinnah, bal jāʾahum bil-ḥaqqi waʾaktharuhum lil-ḥaqqi kārihūn

ar: وَلَوِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلْحَقُّ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ لَفَسَدَتِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَن فِيهِنَّ بَلْ أَتَيْنَٰهُم بِذِكْرِهِمْ فَهُمْ عَن ذِكْرِهِم مُّعْرِضُونَ
en: (71) But if the Truth [i.e., Allāh] had followed their inclinations, the heavens and the earth and whoever is in them would have been ruined. Rather, We have brought them their message,[965] but they, from their message, are turning away.
enNotes: [965]- Or "reminder."
tr: Walawittabaʿal-ḥaqqu ahwāʾahum lafasadatis-samāwātu wal-arḍu waman fīhinn, bal ataynāhum bidhikrihim fahum ʿan dhikrihim muʿriḍūn

ar: أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ خَرْجًا فَخَرَاجُ رَبِّكَ خَيْرٌ وَهُوَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰزِقِينَ
en: (72) Or do you, [O Muḥammad], ask them for payment? But the reward of your Lord is best, and He is the best of providers.
tr: Am tasʾaluhum kharjan fakharāju rabbika khayr, wahuwa khayrur-rāziqīn

ar: وَإِنَّكَ لَتَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
en: (73) And indeed, you invite them to a straight path.
tr: Waʾinnaka latadʿūhum ilā ṣirāṭim mustaqīm

ar: وَإِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ عَنِ ٱلصِّرَٰطِ لَنَٰكِبُونَ
en: (74) But indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter are deviating from the path.
tr: Waʾinnal-ladhīna lā yuʾminūna bil-ākhirati ʿaniṣ-ṣirāṭi lanākibūn

ar: وَلَوْ رَحِمْنَٰهُمْ وَكَشَفْنَا مَا بِهِم مِّن ضُرٍّ لَّلَجُّوا۟ فِى طُغْيَٰنِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ
en: (75) And even if We gave them mercy and removed what was upon them of affliction, they would persist in their transgression, wandering blindly.
tr: Walaw raḥimnāhum wakashafnā mā bihim min ḍurril lalajjū fī ṭughyānihim yaʿmahūn

ar: وَلَقَدْ أَخَذْنَٰهُم بِٱلْعَذَابِ فَمَا ٱسْتَكَانُوا۟ لِرَبِّهِمْ وَمَا يَتَضَرَّعُونَ
en: (76) And We had gripped them with suffering [as a warning], but they did not yield to their Lord, nor did they humbly supplicate, [and will continue thus]
tr: Walaqad akhadhnāhum bil-ʿadhābi famastakānū lirabbihim wamā yataḍarraʿūn

ar: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِم بَابًا ذَا عَذَابٍ شَدِيدٍ إِذَا هُمْ فِيهِ مُبْلِسُونَ
en: (77) Until when We have opened before them a door of severe punishment, immediately they will be therein in despair.
tr: Ḥattā idhā fataḥnā ʿalayhim bāban dhā ʿadhābin shadīdin idhā hum fīhi mublisūn

ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلْأَبْصَٰرَ وَٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةَ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَشْكُرُونَ
en: (78) And it is He who produced for you hearing and vision and hearts [i.e., intellect]; little are you grateful.
tr: Wahuwal-ladhī anshaʾa lakumus-samʿa wal-abṣāra wal-afʾidah, qalīlam mā tashkurūn

ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى ذَرَأَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ
en: (79) And it is He who has multiplied you throughout the earth, and to Him you will be gathered.
tr: Wahuwal-ladhī dharaʾakum fil-arḍi waʾilayhi tuḥsharūn

ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ وَلَهُ ٱخْتِلَٰفُ ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
en: (80) And it is He who gives life and causes death, and His is the alternation of the night and the day. Then will you not reason?
tr: Wahuwal-ladhī yuḥyī wayumītu walahukhtilāful-layli wan-nahār, afalā taʿqilūn

ar: بَلْ قَالُوا۟ مِثْلَ مَا قَالَ ٱلْأَوَّلُونَ
en: (81) Rather,[966] they say like what the former peoples said.
enNotes: [966]- Instead of understanding or reasoning.
tr: Bal qālū mithla mā qālal-awwalūn

ar: قَالُوٓا۟ أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ
en: (82) They said, "When we have died and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?
tr: Qālū aʾidhā mitnā wakunnā turābaw waʿiẓāman aʾinnā lamabʿūthūn

ar: لَقَدْ وُعِدْنَا نَحْنُ وَءَابَآؤُنَا هَٰذَا مِن قَبْلُ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّآ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
en: (83) We have been promised this, we and our forefathers, before; this is not but legends of the former peoples."
tr: Laqad wuʿidnā naḥnu waʾābāʾunā hādhā min qablu in hādhā illā asāṭīrul-awwalīn

ar: قُل لِّمَنِ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَن فِيهَآ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
en: (84) Say, [O Muḥammad], "To whom belongs the earth and whoever is in it, if you should know?"
tr: Qul limanil-arḍu waman fīhā in kuntum taʿlamūn

ar: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِ قُلْ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
en: (85) They will say, "To Allāh." Say, "Then will you not remember?"
tr: Sayaqūlūna lillāh, qul afalā tadhakkarūn

ar: قُلْ مَن رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ ٱلسَّبْعِ وَرَبُّ ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
en: (86) Say, "Who is Lord of the seven heavens and Lord of the Great Throne?"
tr: Qul mar rabbus-samāwātis-sabʿi warabbul-ʿarshil-ʿaẓīm

ar: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِ قُلْ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
en: (87) They will say, "[They belong] to Allāh." Say, "Then will you not fear Him?"
tr: Sayaqūlūna lillāh, qul afalā tattaqūn

ar: قُلْ مَنۢ بِيَدِهِۦ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ وَهُوَ يُجِيرُ وَلَا يُجَارُ عَلَيْهِ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
en: (88) Say, "In whose hand is the realm of all things - and He protects while none can protect against Him - if you should know?"
tr: Qul mam biyadihī malakūtu kulli shayʾiw wahuwa yujīru walā yujāru ʿalayhi in kuntum taʿlamūn

ar: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِ قُلْ فَأَنَّىٰ تُسْحَرُونَ
en: (89) They will say, "[All belongs] to Allāh." Say, "Then how are you deluded?"
tr: Sayaqūlūna lillāh, qul faʾannā tusḥarūn

ar: بَلْ أَتَيْنَٰهُم بِٱلْحَقِّ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَكَٰذِبُونَ
en: (90) Rather, We have brought them the truth, and indeed they are liars.
tr: Bal ataynāhum bil-ḥaqqi waʾinnahum lakādhibūn

ar: مَا ٱتَّخَذَ ٱللَّهُ مِن وَلَدٍ وَمَا كَانَ مَعَهُۥ مِنْ إِلَٰهٍ إِذًا لَّذَهَبَ كُلُّ إِلَٰهٍۭ بِمَا خَلَقَ وَلَعَلَا بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ سُبْحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
en: (91) Allāh has not taken any son, nor has there ever been with Him any deity. [If there had been], then each deity would have taken what it created, and some of them would have [sought to] overcome others. Exalted is Allāh above what they describe [concerning Him].
tr: Mattakhadhallāhu miw waladiw wamā kāna maʿahū min ilāhin idhal ladhahaba kullu ilāhim bimā khalaqa walaʿalā baʿḍuhum ʿalā baʿḍ, subḥānallāhi ʿammā yaṣifūn

ar: عَٰلِمِ ٱلْغَيْبِ وَٱلشَّهَٰدَةِ فَتَعَٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
en: (92) [He is] Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, so high is He above what they associate [with Him].
tr: ʿĀlimil-ghaybi wash-shahādati fataʿālā ʿammā yushrikūn

ar: قُل رَّبِّ إِمَّا تُرِيَنِّى مَا يُوعَدُونَ
en: (93) Say, [O Muḥammad], "My Lord, if You should show me that which they are promised,
tr: Qur rabbi immā turiyannī mā yūʿadūn

ar: رَبِّ فَلَا تَجْعَلْنِى فِى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
en: (94) My Lord, then do not place me among the wrongdoing people."
tr: Rabbi falā tajʿalnī fil-qawmiẓ-ẓālimīn

ar: وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّرِيَكَ مَا نَعِدُهُمْ لَقَٰدِرُونَ
en: (95) And indeed, We are Able to show you what We have promised them.
tr: Waʾinnā ʿalā an nuriyaka mā naʿiduhum laqādirūn

ar: ٱدْفَعْ بِٱلَّتِى هِىَ أَحْسَنُ ٱلسَّيِّئَةَ نَحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَصِفُونَ
en: (96) Repel, by [means of] what is best, [their] evil. We are most knowing of what they describe.
tr: Idfaʿ bil-latī hiya aḥsanus-sayyiʾah, naḥnu aʿlamu bimā yaṣifūn

ar: وَقُل رَّبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ هَمَزَٰتِ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينِ
en: (97) And say, "My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the incitements of the devils,
tr: Waqur rabbi aʿūdhu bika min hamazātish-shayāṭīn

ar: وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ رَبِّ أَن يَحْضُرُونِ
en: (98) And I seek refuge in You, my Lord, lest they be present with me."
tr: Waʾaʿūdhu bika rabbi ay yaḥḍurūn

ar: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَ أَحَدَهُمُ ٱلْمَوْتُ قَالَ رَبِّ ٱرْجِعُونِ
en: (99) [For such is the state of the disbelievers] until, when death comes to one of them, he says, "My Lord, send me back
tr: Ḥattā idhā jāʾa aḥadahumul-mawtu qāla rabbirjiʿūn

ar: لَعَلِّىٓ أَعْمَلُ صَٰلِحًا فِيمَا تَرَكْتُ كَلَّآ إِنَّهَا كَلِمَةٌ هُوَ قَآئِلُهَا وَمِن وَرَآئِهِم بَرْزَخٌ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
en: (100) That I might do righteousness in that which I left behind."[967] No! It is only a word he is saying; and behind them is a barrier until the Day they are resurrected.
enNotes: [967]- Or "in that which I neglected."
tr: Laʿallī aʿmalu ṣāliḥan fīmā taraktu kallā, innahā kalimatun huwa qāʾiluhā, wamiw warāʾihim barzakhun ilā yawmi yubʿathūn

ar: فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَلَآ أَنسَابَ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ وَلَا يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
en: (101) So when the Horn is blown, no relationship will there be among them that Day, nor will they ask about one another.
tr: Faʾidhā nufikha fiṣ-ṣūri falā ansāba baynahum yawmaʾidhiw walā yatasāʾalūn

ar: فَمَن ثَقُلَتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ
en: (102) And those whose scales are heavy [with good deeds] - it is they who are the successful.
tr: Faman thaqulat mawāzīnuhū faʾulāʾika humul-mufliḥūn

ar: وَمَنْ خَفَّتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ فِى جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدُونَ
en: (103) But those whose scales are light - those are the ones who have lost their souls, [being] in Hell, abiding eternally.
tr: Waman khaffat mawāzīnuhū faʾulāʾikal-ladhīna khasirū anfusahum fī jahannama khālidūn

ar: تَلْفَحُ وُجُوهَهُمُ ٱلنَّارُ وَهُمْ فِيهَا كَٰلِحُونَ
en: (104) The Fire will sear their faces, and they therein will have taut smiles.[968]
enNotes: [968]- Their lips having been contracted by scorching until the teeth are exposed.
tr: Talfaḥu wujūhahumun-nāru wahum fīhā kāliḥūn

ar: أَلَمْ تَكُنْ ءَايَٰتِى تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ فَكُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ
en: (105) [It will be said], "Were not My verses recited to you and you used to deny them?"
tr: Alam takun āyātī tutlā ʿalaykum fakuntum bihā tukadhdhibūn

ar: قَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا غَلَبَتْ عَلَيْنَا شِقْوَتُنَا وَكُنَّا قَوْمًا ضَآلِّينَ
en: (106) They will say, "Our Lord, our wretchedness overcame us, and we were a people astray.
tr: Qālū rabbanā ghalabat ʿalaynā shiqwatunā wakunnā qawman ḍāl-līn

ar: رَبَّنَآ أَخْرِجْنَا مِنْهَا فَإِنْ عُدْنَا فَإِنَّا ظَٰلِمُونَ
en: (107) Our Lord, remove us from it, and if we were to return [to evil], we would indeed be wrongdoers."
tr: Rabbanā akhrijnā minhā faʾin ʿudnā faʾinnā ẓālimūn

ar: قَالَ ٱخْسَـُٔوا۟ فِيهَا وَلَا تُكَلِّمُونِ
en: (108) He will say, "Remain despised therein and do not speak to Me.
tr: Qālakhsaʾū fīhā walā tukallimūn

ar: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ فَرِيقٌ مِّنْ عِبَادِى يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَآ ءَامَنَّا فَٱغْفِرْ لَنَا وَٱرْحَمْنَا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ
en: (109) Indeed, there was a party of My servants who said, 'Our Lord, we have believed, so forgive us and have mercy upon us, and You are the best of the merciful.'
tr: Innahū kāna farīqum min ʿibādī yaqūlūna rabbanā āmannā faghfir lanā warḥamnā waʾanta khayrur-rāḥimīn

ar: فَٱتَّخَذْتُمُوهُمْ سِخْرِيًّا حَتَّىٰٓ أَنسَوْكُمْ ذِكْرِى وَكُنتُم مِّنْهُمْ تَضْحَكُونَ
en: (110) But you took them in mockery to the point that they made you forget My remembrance, and you used to laugh at them.
tr: Fattakhadhtumūhum sikhriyyan ḥattā ansawkum dhikrī wakuntum minhum taḍḥakūn

ar: إِنِّى جَزَيْتُهُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ بِمَا صَبَرُوٓا۟ أَنَّهُمْ هُمُ ٱلْفَآئِزُونَ
en: (111) Indeed, I have rewarded them this Day for their patient endurance - that they are the attainers [of success]."
tr: Innī jazaytuhumul-yawma bimā ṣabarū annahum humul-fāʾizūn

ar: قَٰلَ كَمْ لَبِثْتُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ عَدَدَ سِنِينَ
en: (112) [Allāh] will say, "How long did you remain on earth in number of years?"
tr: Qāla kam labithtum fil-arḍi ʿadada sinīn

ar: قَالُوا۟ لَبِثْنَا يَوْمًا أَوْ بَعْضَ يَوْمٍ فَسْـَٔلِ ٱلْعَآدِّينَ
en: (113) They will say, "We remained a day or part of a day; ask those who enumerate."
tr: Qālū labithnā yawman aw baʿḍa yawmin fasʾalil-ʿāddīn

ar: قَٰلَ إِن لَّبِثْتُمْ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا لَّوْ أَنَّكُمْ كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
en: (114) He will say, "You stayed not but a little - if only you had known.
tr: Qāla il labithtum illā qalīlal law annakum kuntum taʿlamūn

ar: أَفَحَسِبْتُمْ أَنَّمَا خَلَقْنَٰكُمْ عَبَثًا وَأَنَّكُمْ إِلَيْنَا لَا تُرْجَعُونَ
en: (115) Then did you think that We created you uselessly and that to Us you would not be returned?"
tr: Afaḥasibtum annamā khalaqnākum ʿabathaw waʾannakum ilaynā lā turjaʿūn

ar: فَتَعَٰلَى ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمَلِكُ ٱلْحَقُّ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ رَبُّ ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْكَرِيمِ
en: (116) So exalted is Allāh, the Sovereign,[969] the Truth;[970] there is no deity except Him, Lord of the Noble Throne.
enNotes:
[969]- And owner of everything in existence.
[970]- Or "the True Reality."
tr: Fataʿālallāhul-malikul-ḥaqq, lā ilāha illā huw, rabbul-ʿarshil-karīm

ar: وَمَن يَدْعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ لَا بُرْهَٰنَ لَهُۥ بِهِۦ فَإِنَّمَا حِسَابُهُۥ عِندَ رَبِّهِۦٓ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُفْلِحُ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ
en: (117) And whoever invokes besides Allāh another deity for which he has no proof - then his account is only with his Lord. Indeed, the disbelievers will not succeed.
tr: Wamay yadʿu maʿallāhi ilāhan ākhara lā burhāna lahū bihī faʾinnamā ḥisābuhū ʿinda rabbih, innahū lā yufliḥul-kāfirūn

ar: وَقُل رَّبِّ ٱغْفِرْ وَٱرْحَمْ وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ
en: (118) And, [O Muḥammad], say, "My Lord, forgive and have mercy, and You are the best of the merciful."
tr: Waqur rabbighfir warḥam waʾanta khayrur-rāḥimīn
